sourceRefs.locator: IX.20, Copy of the Agreement, preamble and clauses on Paris, Clodechild, Childebert’s children, Faileuba, Chlodosind, Galswinth’s cities, the leudes, travel and oaths.
pp. 103–104: Galswinth, marriage property, the immediate grant of Cahors to Brunhild and the four other cities retained by Guntram for his lifetime.

labels.de: Die Einwohner von Cahors in der Besitzklausel
labels.en: People of Cahors in the property clause

summary.de: Der Vertrag nennt die Bevölkerung zusammen mit der Stadt und ihrem Land. Einzelne Haushalte kommen in der Klausel nicht zu Wort.
summary.en: The agreement mentions the people alongside the city and its lands. The clause records nothing about individual households.
